messages:
Alex R.: Heads-up — invoice preview delta for a handful of tenants. Preview vs final invoice tokens off by ~3-15% in some cases. Suspect ledger epoch / commit-window misalignment causing double-counting or missing commits. Anyone seen this recently?

Priya K.: Not on my radar. Which pipeline surface — aggregator, finalizer, or the UI preview join?

metering-bot: alert: commit_window_lag_ms > 60000 on partition=us-east-2-4 for consumer=finalizer-3 (since 2026-03-20T22:01:03Z)

Sam T.: I repro'd this locally. If consumer heartbeat lags, finalizer can advance ledger_epoch before the agg join acknowledges a session, so preview reads partial state. Replaying 10m of events reproduces the ~5% bump.

Devon (metering): Yea — root cause is race between epoch rotation and acking the routing fingerprint dedupe. Two quick forks: 1) finalizer should read epoch from ledger header atomically, OR 2) preview should prefer last-stable-snapshot instead of live reads for route attribution. Both have tradeoffs.

Alex R.: Need a safe short-term mitigation — previews used in Console are customer-facing. Options I see:
  - snapshot previews only (stable but stale)
  - buffer commits for preview for N seconds (reduce variance, increase preview latency)
  - mark preview as "estimated" with variance band in UI (transparent but noisy)
Which is least risky to ship quickly?

Priya K.: I'm leaning to adding an explicit UI indicator + metric for staleness (fast to ship). We can follow with snapshot gating. I'll draft the copy and the metric panel.

Devon (metering): Quick engineering plan: gate preview read path with commit_age check. If commit_age_p95 > 30s then UI shows "preview stale" and backend serves last-stable-snapshot. Small change, canary flag separate per-tenant. Will open PR.

Sam T.: Qs: how do we compute commit_age? We currently have commit_timestamp and ingest_timestamp on events but not an aggregated metric. Proposed ad-hoc query: 

  ```sql
  SELECT route_id, percentile(commit_age_ms, 95) AS p95_age
  FROM metering.commit_events
  WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '10 minutes'
  GROUP BY route_id;
  ```

  That should be enough for a dashboard card + alert.

Priya K.: Perfect — I'll add a per-route "commit_age_p95" card and an alert rule at 30s with severity=low. Also will add the UI copy: "Preview may be delayed — last stable snapshot at {{snapshot_ts}} (±{{variance}})"

Alex R.: Can we also tag telemetry when "commit_epoch != ingest_epoch" in finalizer logs so we can count occurrences? That will help rollout decisions.

Devon (metering): Yep — will add telemetry tag commit_epoch_mismatch=true and emit a short counter. PR coming. Will default canary=false for Dedicated tenants.

Sam T.: One more ops note — finalizer restart during epoch boundaries currently causes a transient where ledger header increments but consumer offsets don't. I'll add a small backoff on epoch advance to avoid churn.

Priya K.: I'll update the runbook to include this case. Also will surface a console toast for affected customers when we detect >1% invoice preview drift.

Alex R.: Love it. @Devon please link the PR here when ready, and @Priya let's sync on copy before you push. Thanks. :thumbsup:

Devon (metering): PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/metering/pulls/412 — feature/preview-staleness-gate. Includes canary flag and telemetry.

Priya K.: UX copy draft pushed to design board. I'll post the link in a bit.

Alex R.: Great work team. We'll monitor the new telemetry next 24h and plan snapshot fallback if drift persists. :eyes:
